row.evidence: Pricing page: Canva Enterprise "includes everything in Business, plus enterprise-level features like advanced brand governance, security with SSO and SCIM"; the help centre says SCIM "is only available to Canva Enterprise and Canva for Districts".
row.notes: Canva Teams is closed to new sign-ups; the team plan is now Canva Business at US$250/year per person (about $20.83/u/mo annual). Pro (US$144/year) is a one-person plan. SSO and SCIM are both Enterprise-only on the pricing page's comparison table, so there is no SSO-without-SCIM middle tier. Legacy Canva Teams orgs that already use SCIM keep it. SCIM is also on Canva for Districts / Education. Enterprise price is not published. The separate Admin API (users, teams, groups, audit events) is Enterprise, District and Campus only. Status unchanged from June. The pricing comparison table now shows plan availability as icons only; c4 quotes the Enterprise card ('SSO and SCIM provisioning'), and the Business/Pro 'not included' flags rest on that card and on the 'everything in Business, plus' wording (c5).

auth.token_source: Settings > SSO and provisioning > Single sign-on (SSO) > Manage > Configure Provisioning > Add provisioning method > SCIM > Enable SCIM user provisioning

deprovision.data_retained: User is removed from the Enterprise team and the account is locked. Designs not transferred stay in the team as ownerless and are reassigned if the person is added back.

roles.how: SCIM role attribute. Default Member; every value other than Member maps to the Canva Brand Designer role. Admin roles are not supported via Okta.

rate_limits.text: Create user is rate limited to 1 request per second.

limitations.text: No SCIM DELETE for users; deprovisioning is PATCH active=false.
Only one email per user, and only type work.
Group members array in API responses is always empty; members are only visible in the Canva web UI.
Group add/remove operations are capped at 1000 members per request.

Developer docs say the SCIM API is not available to multi-team organizations; the help centre says for teams inside an organization structure (single- or multi-team) only user provisioning and deprovisioning work, not provisioning into specific teams or creating groups.
Entra: user deletion via SCIM is not supported; target object actions must be Create and Update only.
Okta: userName cannot be updated via the edit button in the People section.

endpoints.purpose: Create a managed user in the organization (verified domain, SAML IdP of the org)
Update a managed user (name, locale, SAML name ID)
Add an org-managed user to a team
Remove a user from a team
Delete a group and its memberships

limitations.text: Requires a Canva organization (Enterprise, District or Campus); only organization admins with MFA or an SSO-managed account can create API clients.
Access tokens are valid for four hours (OAuth client credentials).
Team member PATCH can only change the member's role.

conflicts.text: The developer docs say SCIM API access is only for Canva Enterprise single teams and not multi-team organizations, while the help centre says user provisioning and deprovisioning are supported for both single-team and multi-team organizations.

open_questions: Docs do not say whether a SCIM-deactivated (locked) user frees a paid Enterprise seat.
Docs do not say whether locking via SCIM revokes active sessions.
Reactivation via PATCH active=true is not documented; the help centre only says re-added members get their ownerless designs back.
ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas, ResourceTypes and Bulk endpoints are not documented.
No enterprise-extension or custom SCIM attributes are documented.
Docs do not state outright that SSO must be configured before SCIM (the SCIM token is generated from inside the SSO settings, and Google's guide requires SSO first).
Admin API rate limits are not documented; no user-event webhooks found.
Admin API: no documented user deactivate/delete endpoint, though the help centre says users, teams and groups support create, read, update and delete.

OneLogin catalogue page (onelogin.com/connector/canva) returned an empty page; Canva's own guide uses the generic SAML Test Connector, so a OneLogin catalogue listing and OneLogin provisioning are unverified.
Enterprise price and seat minimum are not published; CSV bulk import was not checked.
